lines.en: label bargen2:
scene sananightgen2
I walk for quite a while in the snow and wind up at the bar with Sana.
lines.zh: 我在雪里走了好一阵，最后和 Sana 一起到了酒吧。

lines.en: She's in a much better mood than usual, but still displays a sense of uneasiness about my health when she realizes that I'll just be walking back after this.
lines.zh: 她心情比平时好得多，可一意识到我待会儿还得自己走回去，就又露出对我身体的担忧。

lines.en: This is the part where most other girls I know would offer to walk with me or even let me stay over but-
lines.zh: 换成我认识的大多数女孩，这会儿都会提出陪我走，甚至让我留宿——不过——

lines.en: Well, Sana doesn't do either of those things.
She just cracks me open a bottle of the same beer I always buy and spends the next hour or so whispering back about whatever topics I bring up.
lines.zh: 她只是替我开了一瓶我常买的那款啤酒，接下来的一个小时左右，就着我提起的任何话题低声回应。

lines.en: But even if she's just as quiet and slightly-detached as she always is, it's an enjoyable night.
lines.zh: 不过，即便她还是一如既往地安静、略微疏离，这一晚依然很愉快。

lines.en: I just wish she'd show a little more initiative in sparking conversation rather than just going along with whatever I say.
lines.zh: 我只是希望她能更主动一点挑起话题，而不是总跟着我说什么就聊什么。

lines.en: scene black
I stay until closing and then offer to walk Sana back to the dorm since she never personally brought up the prospect of us leaving together.
lines.zh: 我一直待到打烊，然后提出送 Sana 回宿舍——因为她从没主动提过一起走的可能。

lines.en: She gets embarrassed and ultimately refuses, to which I oblige.
lines.zh: 她有些不好意思，最终还是拒绝了，我也就作罢。

lines.en: I obviously don't want her to walk back alone, especially on a night as cold as this, but there's not much I can do about it at this point.
lines.zh: 我当然不想让她一个人走回去，尤其是在这么冷的夜里，但事到如今我也没什么办法。

lines.en: Let's just hope she isn't carried off by the wind and thrown into some nearby body of water to develop hypothermia and die.
lines.zh: 只希望她别被风刮走、掉进附近什么水里，然后失温而死。
